theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G Y : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, κ * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → LipschitzWith L h → Measurable G → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → IntegrableOn Y A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A), ∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = x → Y x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ u ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → ∃ c : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ (∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), Differentiable ℝ f → LipschitzWith K f → ∫ x in A, fderiv ℝ f x (Y x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w (c w)) ∧ ∫ x in A, inner ℝ (G x) (Y x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ (h ∘ Φ) w (c w)
